title: RANKX treats a BLANK as 0: above a negative value

source.quote: If expression or value evaluates to BLANK it is treated as a 0 (zero) for all expressions that result in a number, or as an empty text for all text expressions.

derivation: Without row 4 the values are 10, BLANK, -5. With BLANK read as 0 the descending order is 10, 0, -5: ranks 1, 2, 3. If BLANK sorted below every number it would be last, after -5.
